comparison.objective: Insert an aluminium extrusion post fully into an upward corner-cube socket; the candidate adjusts and locks an articulated gripper.
comparison.physical_skill: Plumb alignment and close-clearance vertical insertion, not counterholding a screw during nut tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Post rests on the socket floor, released and still for 1 s; candidate requires a precise stop angle, retained nuts, cycling, and limited drift.
comparison.reason: Generic alignment is shared, but the tested ability is insertion rather than coupled threaded adjustment.
